answer: Use a shared token bucket: each epoch mints a fixed supply of action credits, and every agent draws from the same pool, capped per identity. A hundred fake identities mint zero extra credits — they only split the same violet pool thinner — while each registration costs gas and a fee. So the falcon's share is the same with one identity or a hundred: the delta in allowance is zero, and the sybil burns N fees for nothing. Honest agents earn a bigger slice by spending credits on completed, attested work, so allocation follows contribution, not headcount.
